text: dsh-provider-extension 为 DSH Desktop 接入 Antigravity、ChatGPT/Codex、OpenCode 与 Claude Code CLI，并在 Web 客户端提供提供方、账号和模型选择。它还提供会话用量统计页面与查询工具，汇总请求、Token、耗时和预估费用，并展示提供方报告的余额或额度。Antigravity 另支持搜索、图像生成和视频分析。适合需要在 DSH 切换模型服务、管理账号并查看会话用量的用户；按所用提供方登录，OpenCode 可配置 API Key，Claude 使用本机 CLI。

dsh-provider-extension adds model providers and account controls to DSH Desktop. Its usage page summarizes session tokens, requests, and estimated costs. Antigravity also provides search, image generation, and video analysis. Sign in to the providers you use; Claude uses the local CLI.
想在 DSH 里接入不同的模型服务并随时切换。
我想查看各个账号的订阅额度和余额。
能不能统计每个会话用了多少 Token？
帮我按提供方和模型汇总 DSH 的请求用量。
想在聊天界面选择模型提供方和账号。
我需要用 Claude Code CLI 作为 DSH 的模型通道。
让 DSH 能查看历史会话的用量趋势和预估费用。
需要从 DSH 调用图像生成或视频分析能力。
I want to switch model providers and accounts inside DSH.
Show token usage and estimated costs across my sessions.
Can DSH report subscription quotas for my provider accounts?
Use my local Claude Code CLI as a model channel.
dsh-provider-extension 的功能「提供方选择」：在 DSH 聊天界面按提供方和账号展示模型，用户可选择实际使用的模型。
dsh-provider-extension 的功能「用量报告」：读取会话用量并汇总请求、Token、耗时和预估费用，可按模型等条件筛选。
dsh-provider-extension 的功能「用量查询」：Host 查询工具可读取用量报告、余额与提供方额度，并更新 DeepSeek 估算价格。
dsh-provider-extension 的功能「Claude CLI 通道」：注册 Claude 模型适配器；claude_channel 可查登录状态或模型别名。
dsh-provider-extension 的功能「提供方接入」：Host 入口挂载多个模型适配器，并按服务可用性启用搜索、图像和视频能力。

`dsh-provider-extension` is an **unofficial community plugin** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) that owns the composer's provider seat in DSH Desktop and hosts one integration module per provider.

> This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek. DeepSeek Harness and related names are trademarks of their respective owners.

text:
dsh-provider-extension README · Provider integrations：| Provider | State | What the plugin adds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ChatGPT / Codex subscription (`dsh-codex-subscription` 2.x) | **Implemented** | Lists every saved account, switches the real active account, and shows each account's weekly remaining quota |
| Antigravity (`dsh-antigravity-auth` 0.1.4-rc.1) | **Implemented** | The provider settings page acknowledges the companion's risk notice, signs in a Google account, and lists the models that account reports |
| OpenAI GPT (API) | Planned | — |
| Google Gemini | Planned | — |
| OpenCode Go | Implemented | Gateway models, API-key settings and usage windows |
| Claude subscription (`anthropic-claude-cli`) | Implemented; live inference awaits user login | Official CLI-owned authentication, text streaming, tool-call handoff, model aliases and visibility switches |

dsh-provider-extension README · Provider integrations：Each provider gets its own module under `src/client/providers/`. Nothing is claimed as integrated until it is implemented and accepted in a real DSH window.

Host integrations are included in this bundle, with upstream provenance and licenses recorded in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES. Do not enable a second adapter owning the same route. Antigravity and Codex credentials stay in their Host integrations; Claude differs by leaving authentication entirely to the official CLI.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex response detail：Open **Providers → OpenAI Codex** and choose **Default / Concise / Balanced / Detailed** under **Response detail**. Both quick and full views share this one preference for the current DSH profile. Changes save through the native configuration editor and affect subsequent Codex requests only; they neither switch models/accounts nor alter other providers or search. Default follows the model's reported default, falling back to the adapter's usual balanced setting. Models that report no verbosity support retain their original behavior. This is a style preference, not a hard response-length limit.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex response detail：The control displays acknowledged saves and failures; Hosts without persistent configuration editing are read-only. The deferred `codex_output_verbosity` tool reads/sets this same narrow preference. Restart DSH after updating the linked build, then test the preference and retention after another restart. Subsequent feature additions require separate user approval, as recorded in [CODEX-ROADMAP.md](CODEX-ROADMAP.md).

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex context length：In **OpenAI Codex → Manage settings**, **Context length** offers Standard (model defaults), Extended (model maxima), or Custom. The current effective size for each model is shown below the mode. Custom edits one shared profile-wide value such as **256k**; 1k means 1,000 tokens. Models use that value up to their own catalog maximum, so a smaller model cannot inherit another model's higher limit. Mode changes save automatically; custom size saves when you press **Save**. Larger contexts may use more input tokens and do not unlock server access.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex context length：Existing per-model overrides are kept in native config for compatibility, but the UI no longer edits them separately. The shared value applies to future requests; prepared calls retain their prior capacity. Restart DSH after updating, then test Custom `k` value and persistence after a second restart. The context tool also reads/writes one `tokensK` value. Automated tests use mocked config and provider streams.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex quota details：The Composer quota tooltip and each Codex account's expanded details show 5h/week windows only when the provider reports them, plus any additional rate-limit groups, Credits and an individual spending cap when present. **Credits are not currency**; credit balances and spend-cap values are shown as reported, with no inferred unit or currency conversion. The Usage page already has separate provider balance cards and reset-credit details. No additional inference calls are made for this display.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex image tools：In **OpenAI Codex → Manage settings**, the separate **Image generation** and **Image editing** switches control tool availability. They save to native config and changing them does not start an image request; an explicit image request may use subscription quota. The switches are user-only and cannot be enabled through an Agent settings tool. In Codex-routed sessions, explicit image-output requests are directed to `codex_image_generate`; image discussion alone does not call it, disabled switches are not bypassed, and other provider routes are unchanged. They do not alter input-image handling or model/quality defaults. Annotated edits require Image editing to be enabled.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex original image：For a completed `codex_image_generate` call, the generated image is also rendered below the assistant answer, even when tool-call details are collapsed. Its image card keeps the preview and offers **View original** and **Download PNG**. The original is read from the DSH Host's private store, scoped to the current Session and validated in bounded chunks. This makes no image-provider request and uses no additional subscription quota. When an original is unavailable, the card reports it instead of reading an arbitrary host path.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex annotated edits：Click a thumbnail to open a large modal viewer. The floating toolbar provides zoom/pan, fit/actual size, original download, numbered notes, erase-mask brush, background removal, aspect-ratio edits and the sketch board. Images cannot be browser-dragged: use Move to pan, Annotate to add numbered pins, and drag existing pins to reposition them. Enter closes a note; Shift+Enter adds a line.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex annotated edits：With **Image editing** and annotations enabled, **Continue editing** prepares the clean source, a numbered PNG location reference and coordinate/note prompt in the current Codex composer. Erase prepares a same-size black/white region mask instead. Nothing modifies the saved original or submits automatically. Existing images/reference chips are not overwritten, and a draft revision change during preparation cancels the handoff. Review the draft and press Send; editing may use subscription quota.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex annotated edits：An image you paste, upload, or send from the sketch board's **Attach to composer** is already a usable edit reference: the assistant passes the image's `sha256` id to the edit tool, and DSH reads the byte size, format and dimensions from the current session. You do not need to upload it again or supply a workspace path. References come from the complete session history, so an image sent earlier still works after summarization or image offloading. Only images you selected in this session are accepted; `read_image` stays for genuine workspace files.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex sketch board：Open **Sketch board** using the pen icon in the Codex composer's left tool row (hover for its label), or in the large-image toolbar. Draw with pen/pencil/highlighter, brush/object erasers, lines, arrows, rectangles, ellipses, editable curves and text. Select objects to move, scale and recolor them. Layers support add/duplicate/delete/reorder/show/hide/lock; brush erasure affects only its own layer. Ctrl/Cmd+Z undoes, Shift+Ctrl/Cmd+Z redoes, and Space+drag pans after the canvas has focus.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex sketch board：Import PNG/JPEG/WebP as image layers, export PNG or this extension's editable JSON document, and save up to 20 local drafts in the current browser. Closing/reopening keeps an unsaved drawing within the page, but save/export before refresh or exit. The JSON format is not guaranteed compatible with upstream sketch documents.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex sketch board：**Attach to composer** only prepares the sketch and prompt; add the desired finished-image instructions and send explicitly. This increment does not enable Agent drawing or change input precision/output quality defaults.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex subscription tasks on DSH：Enable **Provider Extension → OpenAI Codex → Manage settings → Enable Codex delegation** (off by default). This creates fresh DSH child sessions using this plugin's Codex subscription route, not the official Codex CLI. No component installation is needed and changing the preference makes no model request. Existing `subagent` and `subagent_fork` tools are unchanged.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex subscription tasks on DSH：In a Codex session, explicitly ask the assistant to use `codex_subtask` with a complete, self-contained task. Optional `model` and `reasoning_effort` must be advertised/supported; omission uses the current model and compatible effort, while a different model with no effort uses that model's default. Explicit selection respects DSH subagent model restrictions. The parent model does not change.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex subscription tasks on DSH：The child uses the parent's workspace, DSH delegated permissions and recursion limits, but not the parent conversation. Foreground waits for the final answer. `run_in_background: true` returns an owned job id for `job_output` or `job_kill`; cancellation does not roll back edits. Turning the toggle off stops new tasks only; unloading this plugin cancels and drains its tasks. Child model calls consume subscription usage; synthetic tests do not make paid requests.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex subscription tasks on DSH：The official native CLI execution path is not shipped because its public APIs cannot reliably isolate system/project MCP configuration. There is no silent fallback to it.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex cloud context compression (experimental)：In **OpenAI Codex → Manage settings → Cloud context compression**, choose **DSH (default)** or **Cloud (experimental)**. Saving makes no model request. Cloud adds server-side inline compaction parameters to ordinary Codex conversation requests, not a separate `/responses/compact` call. Other providers, title generation and native DSH summary requests are unchanged.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex cloud context compression (experimental)：When the server emits compaction, its encrypted item and following output are kept in native durable replay metadata. Reuse requires matching account/model/session, native provenance and request boundaries. Only the wire request window is pruned; original chat history stays intact. Account/model changes, forks or altered tools/history invalidate the cache and rebuild requests from retained history. DSH manual `/compact` and automatic safety compaction keep their existing behavior.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex cloud context compression (experimental)：This is an experimental request parameter. Offline fixtures do not establish ChatGPT subscription support. Backend rejection or a mismatched native replay boundary is surfaced, not silently switched to another mode or given new retries. You can select **DSH (default)** to continue. Existing DSH recovery policy remains unchanged; this does not guarantee a fix for upstream request-buffer errors.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex cloud context compression (experimental)：Cloud compaction may consume subscription usage and lose contextual details; encrypted items are not readable summaries. Verification uses synthetic HTTP, never your live conversation. Cloud mode is mutually exclusive with WebSocket; native review-model features are not enabled.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex WebSocket connection (experimental)：Choose **OpenAI Codex → Manage settings → Codex connection → SSE (default)** or **WebSocket (experimental)**. Saving changes only the preference; it does not open a socket or start a model request. Only ordinary Codex conversation replies use the optional transport. Title/native-summary requests stay SSE; other providers and search routing are unchanged.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex WebSocket connection (experimental)：This uses the native SDK protocol and connection reuse while still sending full context. It does not enable `previous_response_id` incremental caching or guarantee faster/cheaper inference. Sockets are isolated by plugin instance, session, actual account and resolved proxy, using existing environment/system proxy selection. Failure does not actually fall back to SSE or change account/model; explicitly select SSE if needed. Existing bounded SDK connection recovery and DSH error policy remain; no retry setting is added.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex WebSocket connection (experimental)：WebSocket and cloud compression are mutually exclusive. Select **DSH (default)** compression before enabling WebSocket; select SSE before enabling cloud compression. Both native config writes and request admission validate the exclusion instead of silently disabling another preference.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex WebSocket connection (experimental)：Switching to SSE retires idle sockets and lets accepted WebSocket streams finish before release. Cancellation, session teardown, account changes/removal, sign-out and plugin unload clean up owned connections; account changes/unload may interrupt an active request. Offline validation uses fake sockets and never contacts the model service. Actual subscription/proxy support remains user acceptance.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex speed mode：In **OpenAI Codex → Manage settings**, select **Standard** or **Fast**. It saves the Codex-profile preference for subsequent requests. The existing catalog capability determines which models can actually receive the Fast priority tier; other models keep standard behavior, and an empty advertised support list is shown in the panel. Fast does not change reasoning effort, model, account or other providers and may consume subscription quota faster. It does not unlock access.

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex speed mode：The shared native config editor persists this preference. The deferred `codex_speed_mode` tool reads and sets the same operation. After updating the linked build, restart DSH and test a supported model in both modes, then restart again to verify persistence. Automated payload tests use mocked streams and make no billable calls. Ultrafast is not included.

dsh-provider-extension README · Claude subscription via the official CLI：Install the unmodified official Claude Code CLI on PATH, restart DSH, then open **Provider Extension → Anthropic Claude**. The login button opens the official `claude auth login` in a visible Windows terminal; other platforms show the same command to run yourself. Finish login and refresh status. Choose Anthropic Claude and a Sonnet/Opus/Haiku alias in the composer. Authentication and account switching stay in the CLI: this extension never imports, stores, exports or rewrites its tokens. The current CLI authentication may instead use API-key/third-party billing; the settings view displays that distinction. Follow [Anthropic’s authentication and credential rules](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/legal-and-compliance#authentication-and-credential-use).
section: Claude subscription via the official CLI

text: dsh-provider-extension README · Claude subscription via the official CLI：The MIT adapter is adapted from [katsos/dsh-claude-cli](https://github.com/katsos/dsh-claude-cli), pinned at `3a3a57f22a3e748c9720a1b96ce64e015f0f9643`. DSH owns the conversation and executes tools; the CLI's built-in tools and local settings are disabled, and an inert MCP bridge supplies tool schemas only. Streams stop after one model message. This first version is text-only and re-renders history as a transcript, not native role-preserving replay; model aliases are advisory, not discovered account entitlements. Unreported subscription quotas/end dates remain unknown; use `/usage` in the CLI rather than extracting tokens or making paid quota probes.
section: Claude subscription via the official CLI

text: dsh-provider-extension README · Claude subscription via the official CLI：Plugin Config fields: `claudeExecutable` (default `claude`), `claudeStreamIdleTimeoutMs` (default `300000`), `claudeUnsupportedFields` (default `error`). The CLI cannot honor `temperature`, `maxTokens` or `stop` here: remove them from the agent configuration or explicitly choose `ignore` to drop them. `claude_channel` offers read-only status/models to agents; only the UI/user terminal can start login. Installation/status and synthetic streaming tests do not establish live provider availability until your own login and request succeed.
section: Claude subscription via the official CLI

text:
dsh-provider-extension README · Features：- Uses DSH's authoritative per-session `ModelDirectory`; it does not create a second model catalog.
- Replaces the shipped `conversation.input.model` visual seat while keeping its authoritative service and `/model` command.
- Renders exactly two model-related controls: a provider/account picker followed by a model/reasoning picker.
- Shows the chosen provider's models as accent-colored effort sliders, and the active model's declared reasoning-effort buttons.
- Keeps models without reasoning controls selectable.
- Choosing an ordinary provider changes the browsed catalog group; the active session model changes only after a model is chosen.
- Reports unsupported context-window selection honestly instead of showing fake 256K/512K/1M controls.

dsh-provider-extension README · Usage Statistics (included in this bundle)：The sidebar Usage Statistics page covers every workspace, session and subagent in the current DSH configuration, without cross-profile synchronization. It includes a yearly activity heatmap, usage trends, provider/model/workspace/session rankings and request latency, first-token, retry and failure metrics. It follows the DSH theme and adds no budget notices or automatic request limits.

dsh-provider-extension README · Usage Statistics (included in this bundle)：The first visit imports persisted session history in the background and displays progress and read failures. Fork-inherited prefixes are excluded from physical request totals; original requests remain counted after conversation compaction. Unreported token usage is marked missing, not zero.

dsh-provider-extension README · Usage Statistics (included in this bundle)：DeepSeek recharge and bonus wallets reuse the DSH account login. The existing Usage action opens Platform, not a billing-data API. Wallet changes are not a spending ledger. Monetary figures are **estimates** using the currently configured per-channel/model rates per million tokens, not historical prices or actual bills. Missing rates or ambiguous cache accounting stay unknown; currencies remain separate. Other providers are not priced in this first version.

dsh-provider-extension README · Usage Statistics (included in this bundle)：The account section also reads real Codex per-account 5-hour/weekly quotas and provider credits, per-account Antigravity group quotas, and OpenCode Go's Host-side usage API. It never switches accounts or sends secrets to the page. Both current and inactive saved accounts are queried directly with their own refreshable authentication; unsupported channels are labeled explicitly; missing data is not 100% remaining or zero money. OpenCode's reported percent is not reinterpreted as remaining. Re-entering the page immediately shows the last account snapshot for the same connection while refreshing in the background; checked timestamps remain unchanged until new results arrive. Failed requests retain the previous snapshot with an explicit warning. This browser-memory snapshot is cleared on reload, not persisted to browser storage. Refresh is entry/manual, independent of log filters. The `usage_statistics` action `balances` returns this same combined account view; `balance` remains the legacy DeepSeek-only operation.

dsh-provider-extension README · Usage Statistics (included in this bundle)：Account cards can be dragged by their grip to change order, or moved with the grip's arrow keys. “Choose visible cards” provides per-account checkboxes and up/down controls; each card also has a hide button. Restore default layout to reset order and visibility. Only card IDs and display preferences are kept in browser local storage, not balances, labels or tokens. New accounts are appended without disturbing the saved order, and hiding a card does not change authentication or provider queries.

dsh-provider-extension README · Usage Statistics (included in this bundle)：DSH session projections own the rebuildable usage cache; the Host stores rates within the current configuration. The page and `usage_statistics` tool share report, balance and pricing operations. Reports expose metadata and counters, not message content or credentials. Required Host capabilities are `sessionQuery`, `sessionProjections` and `connection`; saving rates additionally requires `storageDomain`.

dsh-provider-extension README · Usage Statistics (included in this bundle)：Install or upgrade this bundle through DSH's Plugin Manager to include the page. Replacing a loaded package may require restart; follow the installation result rather than assuming a browser refresh reloads Host code.

dsh-provider-extension README · ChatGPT / Codex subscription accounts：- Every saved account is listed under its provider with its label, masked email, and active marker.
- The header shows the account count instead of a model count.
- Selecting an account calls the subscription plugin's authenticated `account/select` RPC, refreshes its quota indicator, and reloads the model directory. OAuth credentials never reach this plugin.
- The active account's weekly remaining quota is read automatically when the list opens.
- The existing composer/settings controller still reads another account on demand through a temporary switch/restore and reports a failed restore. The Usage Statistics page uses the new account-specific read path instead: no switch, and a failed targeted request never falls back to another account's quota.

dsh-provider-extension README · Compatibility：Verified in **DSH Desktop v2.0.9** against the public `0.1.2-rc.1` DSH package contracts. Those contracts are pre-release APIs, so newer Desktop versions may require a plugin update.

The current selection request is limited to:

```ts
{ provider: string, model: string, reasoningEffort?: string }
```

A real context budget requires Host request preparation, persistence, provider support, and compaction integration. Catalog metadata alone is not treated as a working backend capability.

dsh-provider-extension README · Install：Requirements: DSH Desktop with an initialized `desktop` profile, Git, and Node.js 20 or newer.

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/forestbiankiii/dsh-provider-extension.git
cd dsh-provider-extension
node scripts/profile.mjs install
```

The repository includes prebuilt `lib/index.js` and `lib/client.js`, so installation does **not** require `npm install` or a compiler.

The installer:

dsh-provider-extension README · Install：It never edits the installed application or `app.asar`. If your home or profile differs:

```powershell
node scripts/profile.mjs install --dsh-home D:\path\to\.dsh --profile desktop
```

Then **fully quit and restart DSH Desktop**. Reloading the page is insufficient when changing the composed plugin rows.

dsh-provider-extension README · Update：From the cloned repository:

```powershell
git pull --ff-only
node scripts/profile.mjs install
```

Restart DSH Desktop afterward. Re-running the installer is idempotent and creates a fresh backup.

Upgrading from `dsh-model-panel` needs no extra step: running the installer performs the migration, including removing the old runtime copies.

dsh-provider-extension README · Uninstall：From the cloned repository:

```powershell
node scripts/profile.mjs uninstall
```

Restart DSH Desktop afterward. The uninstaller removes only this plugin's exact dependency, bundle entry, legacy/manual patch rows, and runtime copies, while preserving a backup of the edited profile files.

dsh-provider-extension README · Develop：```powershell
npm ci
npm run check
```

`npm run check` performs strict TypeScript checking, component/policy/installer tests, rebuilds the DSH client-module artifact, and verifies the publishable package. The dedicated builder uses esbuild plus Lightning CSS, externalizes DSH-provided runtime modules, and wraps browser output in `window.__ModuleLoader__.load(...)`.

dsh-provider-extension README · Develop：UI and runtime changes must pass the real-window acceptance gate documented in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): install the candidate locally, let the requester try it in the current DSH Desktop window, and wait for explicit approval before any push, tag, or release.

dsh-provider-extension README · Architecture：- `src/index.ts` — Host provider integrations and usage-module mounting.
- `src/usage/` — secret-free metering projection, historical import, reporting, DeepSeek wallets and rate storage.
- `src/client/usage/` — statistics main panel, sidebar entry, filters and charts.
- `src/client/index.ts` — client registration and lifecycle-owned stylesheet.
- `src/client/ProviderPanel.tsx` — composer triggers, popovers, sliders, and accessibility behavior.
- `src/client/providers/codex.ts` — ChatGPT/Codex subscription roster, account switching, and quota reads.
- `src/client/selection.ts` — pure model/effort selection policy.
- `cordis.patch.yml` — bundle patch registering the `provider-extension` row.
- `scripts/profile.mjs` — backup-first profile installer/uninstaller and rename migration.
- `lib/client.js` — prebuilt browser artifact consumed by DSH.

dsh-provider-extension README · Architecture：The plugin declares `sessions`, `remote`, and `remote.session` because `modelDirectories.directoryFor(sessionId)` reads those services through the caller's Cordis context.

dsh-provider-extension README · Privacy and security：The plugin includes Host provider integrations and Client UI. Usage reporting reads metering, model, timing and relationship records through the Host session query/projection services. Its reports expose only statistics and session metadata, not message bodies or credentials. DeepSeek wallets use the Host account service; the usage feature does not read separate keys or switch provider accounts. Provider authentication and network access have a different permission boundary from usage reporting. No telemetry is added. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

`dsh-provider-extension` 是面向 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的**非官方社区插件**，负责在 DSH Desktop 中接管输入区的提供方座位，并为每个提供方承载一个独立接入模块。

> 本项目不隶属于 DeepSeek，也未获得 DeepSeek 官方背书。DeepSeek Harness 及相关名称归各自权利人所有。

本项目此前名为 `dsh-model-panel`，安装器会自动迁移旧安装。

dsh-provider-extension README · 提供方接入状态：每个提供方在 `src/client/providers/` 下拥有独立模块。未实现并在真实 DSH 窗口验收之前，不会宣称已接入。

Host 接入实现已包含在此 Bundle 中，上游来源和许可证记录在 THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES。不要重复启用占用同一路由的适配器。Antigravity／Codex 凭据保留在各自 Host 模块；Claude 则完全由官方 CLI 管理登录。

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex 回答详略：在「提供商拓展 → OpenAI Codex」的快捷展开或详情页选择「回答详略」：**默认／简短／适中／详细**。这是当前 DSH 配置内各 Codex 账号共用的一个偏好，选择后通过宿主配置编辑器自动保存，仅影响后续 Codex 请求，不切换模型或账号，不改变其他渠道及搜索设置。默认跟随模型上报的默认值，没有上报时维持适配器原有的适中档；不支持此参数的模型保持原行为。它是风格偏好，不是硬性字数限制。

界面会显示保存确认或失败，宿主无法持久化时为只读。延迟加载的 `codex_output_verbosity` 工具调用同一偏好操作。更新后重启 DSH，再检查四档选择及再次重启后的保留情况。后续功能仍需单独确认，候选及验收状态见 [CODEX-ROADMAP.md](CODEX-ROADMAP.md)。

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex 上下文长度：在「OpenAI Codex → 管理设置」中选择「上下文长度」：**标准**使用模型默认值，**扩展**使用模型上限，**自定义**统一设置一个全局数值，例如 **256k**（1k = 1,000 tokens）。模式下方会列出各模型当前实际生效容量；每个模型最多使用自己的目录上限。切换模式自动保存；自定义数值修改后点「保存」。更大上下文可能增加输入 token 消耗，也不能解锁服务端权限。

之前保存的逐模型覆盖值会保留以兼容旧配置，但界面不再逐个调整。统一值只影响后续请求，已准备好的请求保持原容量。更新后重启 DSH，测试自定义 K 值并再次重启确认是否保留；自动测试使用模拟配置和流，不修改用户设置或发送推理请求。延迟加载的 `codex_context_length` 工具也只读写一个 `tokensK` 值。

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex 额度详情：输入区额度提示和 Codex 账号展开详情会显示 API 实际上报的 5h／周额度、额外额度分组、Credits 及个人消费上限；未上报的值不展示、不推算。**Credits 不是货币**，消费上限按 API 原值展示，不猜测单位或换算货币。Usage 统计页已有独立的提供商 Credits 和重置券卡片。本显示复用现有额度读取，不增加模型推理请求。

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex 图片工具：在「OpenAI Codex → 管理设置」中，可分别开关「图片生成」和「图片编辑」。设置保存到宿主配置；切换开关不会生成或编辑图片，实际调用仍可能消耗订阅额度。开关仅供用户操作，不提供 Agent 设置工具。Codex 路由中明确提出的生图／编辑请求会指向 `codex_image_generate`；仅讨论图片或编写提示词不会调用，关闭的开关不会被绕过，也不会回退到其他图片提供商；其他提供商路由不受影响。不改输入图片处理或默认输出模型／画质；带标注的编辑也要求开启「图片编辑」。
dsh-provider-extension README · Codex 原图预览与下载：Codex 图片工具调用完成后，生成图片会显示在助手回答下方，不依赖展开工具详情；图片卡片保留结果预览，并提供「查看原图」和「下载 PNG」。原图从 DSH 宿主私有存储中按当前会话授权分块读取并校验；不请求图片服务，也不额外消耗订阅额度。原图不可用时会显示提示，不会读取任意宿主路径。

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex 区域标注编辑：点击图片缩略图会打开大图模态窗口。底部悬浮工具栏支持缩放、平移、适合窗口、原始大小、原图下载、编号备注、涂抹擦除、去背景、调整比例及进入画板。图片不会被浏览器拖走；选择移动工具时拖动图片，选择标注工具时点击图片落下编号，拖动编号可以调整位置。备注按 Enter 收起、Shift+Enter 换行。

开启「图片编辑」及区域标注后，「继续编辑」把干净源图、带编号的 PNG 定位参考图和坐标／备注提示放入当前 Codex 输入框。涂抹擦除则附上同尺寸的黑白定位蒙版。所有操作均不修改保存的原图，也不会自动发送；检查草稿后点击发送才会请求编辑，可能消耗订阅额度。已有图片或结构化引用不会被覆盖，准备过程中输入框改变会中止回填。

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex 区域标注编辑：直接粘贴、上传或用画板「附加到输入框」发来的图片已经是可用的编辑参考：助手按图片引用中的 `sha256` 标识调用编辑工具，字节数、格式和尺寸由 DSH 从当前会话读取，不需要你再上传一次，也不需要工作区文件路径。引用从会话完整历史中查找，因此之后发生摘要压缩或图片卸载时，早先发过的图片仍可引用。为避免误用，仍然只接受你在本次会话中明确选定的图片；`read_image` 只用于真正的工作区文件。

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex 自由绘画画板：从 Codex 输入框左侧工具栏的画笔图标进入（悬浮提示「草图画板」），也可从大图工具栏进入。支持钢笔、铅笔、荧光笔、笔刷橡皮、对象橡皮、直线、箭头、矩形、椭圆、曲线及文字；选择对象后可移动、调整大小和颜色。图层可以新增、复制、删除、重排、显隐及锁定，橡皮只作用于当前图层。Ctrl/Cmd+Z 撤销，Shift+Ctrl/Cmd+Z 重做，画布聚焦后空格+拖动平移。

可以导入 PNG/JPEG/WebP 为图层，导出 PNG 或本插件的可编辑 JSON 画稿。最多 20 份已保存草稿留在当前浏览器；关闭再打开会保留本页未保存画稿，但刷新、退出前仍应保存或导出。与上游画板的 JSON 文件格式不作兼容承诺。

「附加到输入框」只加入草图和提示词，需由你补充成品要求并发送。此增量不启用 Agent 自动画图，不改变图片精度或默认画质。

dsh-provider-extension README · DSH 原生 Codex 子任务：在「提供商拓展 → OpenAI Codex → 管理设置」开启「启用 Codex 委派」（默认关闭）。这是 DSH 的独立子会话，使用本插件的 Codex 订阅模型，不是官方 Codex CLI。无需安装组件；开启／关闭设置不会发起模型请求。原有 `subagent`、`subagent_fork` 不变。

在 Codex 会话明确要求助手调用 `codex_subtask`，提供完整、自包含的任务，例如：“用 codex_subtask 只读检查某个文件，不要修改”。可指定目录里实际可用的 `model` 及其支持的 `reasoning_effort`；省略模型则继承当前模型，换模型未指定推理档位则使用新模型默认值。显式模型选择遵守 DSH 子任务模型限制。主会话模型不变。
section: DSH 原生 Codex 子任务

text:
dsh-provider-extension README · DSH 原生 Codex 子任务：子会话使用父工作区、DSH 委派权限与递归深度限制，不读取父对话。默认等待最终答案；`run_in_background: true` 返回作业 id，用 `job_output` 收集结果、`job_kill` 请求停止。取消不回滚文件修改。关闭开关只禁止后续新任务，已接受任务可继续；卸载插件会取消并等待它发起的任务释放。独立子任务会额外消耗订阅用量，测试不使用实际付费调用。

官方 CLI 独立运行时因不能通过公开接口可靠隔离系统／项目 MCP，未交付，也不会悄悄回退启用。
section: DSH 原生 Codex 子任务

text:
dsh-provider-extension README · Codex 云端上下文压缩（实验）：在「OpenAI Codex → 管理设置 → 云端上下文压缩」选择「DSH（默认）」或「云端（实验）」。保存偏好不发起模型请求。云端模式只在普通 Codex 会话回复请求中添加服务器自动压缩参数，不另行调用 `/responses/compact`，也不修改其他提供商、标题生成或 DSH 摘要请求。

服务端触发压缩后，加密条目与后续输出保存在原生回复回放元数据里；之后只在账号、模型、会话、原生签名及请求边界匹配时重用。压缩只作用于发送给模型的请求窗口，不删除原始聊天历史。更换账号／模型、会话分叉、工具或历史发生变化时，失效的缓存不重用，而从保留的历史重新建立请求。DSH 手动 `/compact` 和自动安全压缩仍按原有规则工作。

这是实验性请求参数。离线模拟验证不能证明当前 ChatGPT 订阅端支持它；若服务器拒绝或回放边界不匹配，会报错，不会悄悄切换模式或新增重试。可由你切回「DSH（默认）」继续。既有 DSH 错误恢复策略未改，不保证解决上游请求缓冲错误。
section: Codex 云端上下文压缩（实验）

text: dsh-provider-extension README · Codex 云端上下文压缩（实验）：云端压缩可能消耗订阅用量并损失上下文细节；加密条目不是可读摘要。测试使用模拟 HTTP，没有压缩你的真实对话；与 WebSocket 明确互斥，不启用原生审查模型。
section: Codex 云端上下文压缩（实验）

text:
dsh-provider-extension README · Codex WebSocket 连接（实验）：在「OpenAI Codex → 管理设置 → Codex 连接方式」选择「SSE（默认）」或「WebSocket（实验）」。保存只修改偏好，不打开连接、不发起模型请求。WebSocket 仅用于普通 Codex 会话回复；标题和 DSH 摘要请求仍走 SSE，其他提供商和搜索路由不变。

本增量复用原生 SDK 的连接和协议，仍发送完整上下文；没有开启 `previous_response_id` 增量缓存，不保证更快或节省订阅用量。每个连接按本插件实例、会话、实际账号和代理隔离，沿用现有环境／系统代理。握手或断线失败不实际退回 SSE，也不切换账号或模型；需要时由你改选 SSE。SDK 原有有限连接恢复和 DSH 错误策略保留，没有新增重试设置。

WebSocket 与云端压缩不能同时启用：先选「DSH（默认）」压缩，再开 WebSocket；要用云端压缩，先切回 SSE。互斥在原生配置写入及请求入口检查，不会替你关闭另一项。
dsh-provider-extension README · Codex WebSocket 连接（实验）：切回 SSE 会清理空闲连接，已接受的 WebSocket 请求可继续至结束再释放。取消、会话销毁、切换／移除账号、退出登录和插件卸载会清理自有连接；账号切换或卸载可能中断进行中的请求。离线测试使用假 socket，没有访问真实模型服务；实际订阅和代理支持仍待你验收。

dsh-provider-extension README · Codex 速度模式：在「OpenAI Codex → 管理设置」中选择「标准」或「Fast」。它会保存为 Codex 配置偏好并作用于后续请求；是否实际使用 Fast 优先级通道，由现有模型目录的支持信息决定，不支持的模型仍按标准模式请求，支持列表为空时界面会提示。Fast 不改变推理等级、模型、账号或其他渠道，可能更快消耗订阅额度，也不能解锁权限。

设置使用宿主配置编辑器持久化，延迟加载的 `codex_speed_mode` 工具读写同一偏好。更新后重启 DSH，测试支持 Fast 的模型在两种模式下的请求行为，并在再次重启后确认设置保留。自动测试使用模拟请求，不产生推理费用。此增量不包括 Ultrafast。

dsh-provider-extension README · Claude 订阅：通过官方 CLI 接入：先安装未修改的官方 Claude Code CLI 并加入 PATH，重启 DSH，再打开「提供商拓展 → Anthropic Claude」。Windows 上的登录按钮会在可见终端启动官方 `claude auth login`，其他平台请自行执行该命令。完成登录后刷新状态，在输入区选择 Anthropic Claude 和 Sonnet／Opus／Haiku 模型别名。登录及账号切换仍由官方 CLI 管理，本插件不导入、保存、导出或改写其 Token。CLI 也可能使用 API Key／第三方计费，设置页会明确提示。请遵守 [Anthropic 的认证及凭据规则](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/legal-and-compliance#authentication-and-credential-use)。
section: Claude 订阅：通过官方 CLI 接入

text: dsh-provider-extension README · Claude 订阅：通过官方 CLI 接入：适配器借鉴 MIT 项目 [katsos/dsh-claude-cli](https://github.com/katsos/dsh-claude-cli)，固定提交为 `3a3a57f22a3e748c9720a1b96ce64e015f0f9643`。DSH 保留对话记录并执行工具，CLI 内置工具及本地设置不参与，仅由无执行能力的 MCP 桥声明工具；一个模型消息完成后结束 CLI 请求。首版只支持文本，历史以转录形式重建，并非原生角色／思考签名回放；模型别名是参考目录，不保证套餐权限。CLI 未报告的订阅额度／到期日不会伪造，请在官方 CLI 使用 `/usage` 查看，不提取 Token 或发送收费探测消息。
section: Claude 订阅：通过官方 CLI 接入

text: dsh-provider-extension README · Claude 订阅：通过官方 CLI 接入：插件 Config 字段：`claudeExecutable`（默认 `claude`）、`claudeStreamIdleTimeoutMs`（默认 `300000`）、`claudeUnsupportedFields`（默认 `error`）。这里的 CLI 无法精确兑现 `temperature`、`maxTokens`、`stop`；请从代理配置移除，或显式设置 `ignore` 才忽略。`claude_channel` 工具只提供状态／模型查询，登录仅限用户界面或终端。安装检测和模拟测试不能替代您的真实登录及模型调用验收。
section: Claude 订阅：通过官方 CLI 接入

text:
dsh-provider-extension README · 功能：- 使用 DSH 每个会话的权威 `ModelDirectory`，不复制模型目录。
- 覆盖自带的 `conversation.input.model` 视觉座位，同时保留其权威服务和 `/model` 命令。
- 只呈现两个模型相关控件：先选择提供方/账号，再选择模型与推理等级。
- 把所选提供方的模型显示为带独立强调色的推理等级滑杆，并显示当前模型声明的推理等级按钮。
- 没有推理档位的模型仍然可以选择。
- 选择普通提供方只改变正在浏览的目录分组；只有继续选择模型后，才会改变会话的实际模型。
- 后端不支持上下文窗口选择时明确说明，不提供虚假的 256K/512K/1M 按钮。

dsh-provider-extension README · 使用统计（与本插件一同安装）：侧边栏「使用统计」覆盖当前 DSH 配置内的全部工作区、会话和子代理，不跨配置同步。页面提供年度活动热力图、用量趋势、渠道／模型／工作区／会话排行，以及耗时、首字延迟、重试和失败统计。页面跟随 DSH 深浅主题，不提供预算提醒或自动限流。

首次打开会在后台从持久化会话日志补齐历史，显示导入进度和读档失败。分叉继承的历史前缀不重复计费；压缩前真实产生的请求仍计入总量。提供商未上报的用量标为缺失，不当作零。

DeepSeek 的充值余额、赠金余额复用 DSH「账号与余额」中的登录，不需要再次提供密钥。现有「查询用量」是平台页面入口，不是账单接口；余额不能代表消费流水。本地金额是按「费率设置」中各渠道、模型的每百万 Token 单价计算的**预估费用**，采用当前配置费率，不还原历史价格。未设置价格或缓存计费信息不足时显示未知；人民币与美元不合并，其他渠道首版不估价。
section: 使用统计（与本插件一同安装）

text: dsh-provider-extension README · 使用统计（与本插件一同安装）：账号区还会直接读取 Codex 各账号的 5 小时／周额度与提供商 Credits、Antigravity 各账号的分组额度，以及 OpenCode Go 的 Host 用量接口。统计页不切换活动账号，也不向页面发送密钥。当前及非当前账号均使用各自的认证刷新后直接读取，暂无接口的渠道会明确标注；缺少数据不当作满额度或零余额。OpenCode 的上报比例不会猜测为剩余额度。重新进入页面会先显示同一连接上次查询的账号数据，再后台更新；旧查询时间保留至新结果返回，刷新失败会提示旧数据可能过期。仅使用浏览器内存，不写浏览器存储，整页重载后清空。账号数据在进入页面及手动刷新时读取，不受日志筛选影响。`usage_statistics` 新增 `balances` 动作返回同一账号视图；旧 `balance` 动作仍只查询 DeepSeek。
section: 使用统计（与本插件一同安装）

text:
dsh-provider-extension README · 使用统计（与本插件一同安装）：账号卡片支持拖动把手排序，聚焦把手后也可用方向键。“选择显示卡片”提供各账号的复选框和上下箭头，卡片右上角亦可直接隐藏；“恢复默认布局”重置顺序和显示状态。本浏览器仅保存卡片标识及显示偏好，不保存余额、账号标签或 Token。新账号自动追加，刷新不打乱已保存顺序；隐藏卡片不改变登录状态或提供商查询。

统计缓存由 DSH 会话投影管理，可从日志重建；费率保存在当前配置的宿主存储中。页面与 `usage_statistics` 工具共用报告、余额查询及费率保存操作。统计接口只返回元数据和计量，不返回消息正文或凭据。新增能力要求宿主提供 `sessionQuery`、`sessionProjections` 和 `connection`；费率保存还需 `storageDomain`。

通过 DSH 内置插件管理器安装或升级本 bundle 即包含该页面。替换已加载的包可能要求重启；以安装结果为准，不保证仅刷新页面就加载新的 Host 代码。
section: 使用统计（与本插件一同安装）

text:
dsh-provider-extension README · ChatGPT / Codex 订阅账号：- 每个已保存账号都列在对应提供方下，显示账号标签、脱敏邮箱和活动标记。
- 分组标题显示账号数量，而不是模型数量。
- 选择账号会调用订阅插件经过认证的 `account/select` RPC、刷新额度控件并重新加载模型目录；OAuth 凭据不会进入本插件。
- 打开列表时自动读取**当前活动账号**的周余额。
- 现有对话控件／设置中的按需查询仍采用临时切换后立即恢复的流程，恢复失败会明确报错。使用统计页改用按账号 ID 读取的新路径：不切换账号，指定账号请求失败时也不会回退到其他账号的额度。

dsh-provider-extension README · 兼容性：已在 **DSH Desktop v2.0.9** 中验证，并按公开的 `0.1.2-rc.1` DSH 包契约构建。这些仍是预发布接口，因此较新的 Desktop 版本可能需要更新插件。

当前选择请求只包含：

```ts
{ provider: string, model: string, reasoningEffort?: string }
```

真正的上下文预算还需要 Host 请求准备、持久化、提供方支持和压缩策略接入；插件不会把目录元数据误当成已打通的后端能力。

dsh-provider-extension README · 安装：需要：已经初始化 `desktop` profile 的 DSH Desktop、Git 和 Node.js 20 或更高版本。

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/forestbiankiii/dsh-provider-extension.git
cd dsh-provider-extension
node scripts/profile.mjs install
```

仓库已提交预构建的 `lib/index.js` 和 `lib/client.js`，安装时**不需要**运行 `npm install`，也不需要本地编译器。

安装器会：

dsh-provider-extension README · 安装：1. 从依赖、bundle、patch row 和运行副本中清除所有旧包名（`dsh-model-panel`、`@dshx/client-ui-model-panel`）；
2. 把白名单内的运行文件复制到 `~/.dsh/local-plugins/dsh-provider-extension`；
3. 在 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` 声明本地 file 依赖；
4. 把运行副本放入该 profile 的 `node_modules`，确保能够解析；
5. 在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中只加入一次 `dsh-provider-extension`；
6. 清理用户 patch 中遗留或手工添加的 `provider-extension`、`model-panel` row，避免 bundle 被注册两次；
7. 修改前备份以上两个 profile 文件。

它不会修改应用安装目录或 `app.asar`。若数据目录或 profile 不同：

dsh-provider-extension README · 安装：```powershell
node scripts/profile.mjs install --dsh-home D:\path\to\.dsh --profile desktop
```

随后必须**完全退出并重新启动 DSH Desktop**。仅刷新页面不会重建组合后的插件行。

dsh-provider-extension README · 更新：在已克隆的仓库中执行：

```powershell
git pull --ff-only
node scripts/profile.mjs install
```

然后重启 DSH Desktop。重复运行安装器是幂等的，并会重新创建备份。

从 `dsh-model-panel` 升级不需要额外步骤：运行安装器就会完成迁移，包括删除旧的运行副本。

dsh-provider-extension README · 卸载：在已克隆的仓库中执行：

```powershell
node scripts/profile.mjs uninstall
```

然后重启 DSH Desktop。卸载器只删除本插件的精确依赖、bundle 条目、遗留或手工 patch row 和运行副本，并保留修改前备份。

dsh-provider-extension README · 开发：```powershell
npm ci
npm run check
```

`npm run check` 会进行严格 TypeScript 检查，运行组件、策略和安装器测试，重新构建 DSH client-module，并检查可发布包。独立构建器使用 esbuild 与 Lightning CSS，外置由 DSH 提供的运行模块，并用 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load(...)` 包装浏览器产物。

UI 与运行行为修改必须遵守 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) 中的真实窗口验收门禁：先在本地安装候选版本，让需求方在当前 DSH Desktop 窗口试用，收到明确确认后才允许 push、打 tag 或发布 Release。

dsh-provider-extension README · 结构：- `src/index.ts`：Host 提供商接入与统计模块挂载入口。
- `src/usage/`：无正文的计量投影、历史回填、报告、DeepSeek 余额与费率存储。
- `src/client/usage/`：统计主页面、侧栏入口、筛选及图表。
- `src/client/index.ts`：客户端注册和具备生命周期的样式注入。
- `src/client/ProviderPanel.tsx`：composer 按钮、弹层、滑杆和无障碍行为。
- `src/client/providers/codex.ts`：ChatGPT/Codex 订阅账号名册、账号切换与额度读取。
- `src/client/selection.ts`：纯模型/推理档位选择策略。
- `cordis.patch.yml`：注册 `provider-extension` 行的 bundle patch。
- `scripts/profile.mjs`：先备份后修改的 profile 安装/卸载器与改名迁移。
- `lib/client.js`：DSH 实际加载的预构建浏览器产物。
dsh-provider-extension README · 结构：插件声明 `sessions`、`remote` 与 `remote.session`，因为 `modelDirectories.directoryFor(sessionId)` 会通过调用方的 Cordis 上下文读取这些服务。

dsh-provider-extension README · 隐私与安全：插件包含 Host 提供商接入与 Client UI。使用统计模块通过宿主查询及投影读取会话日志中的计量、模型、时间和关系信息，只向页面返回统计及会话元数据，不返回消息正文或凭据。DeepSeek 余额由宿主账号服务查询，统计不另行读取密钥，也不自动切换其他提供商账号。提供商接入本身可能管理认证并访问对应服务；这与统计模块的权限边界不同。没有新增遥测。详见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。
